result.summary: The page is largely well-structured and consistent. The only visually broken element is the burger illustration in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, whose layers appear misaligned (the bottom bun is detached and offset from the rest of the burger). Horizontal clipping and bottom-viewport cutoff were treated as intended behavior and not reported.

issues.description: In the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card image, the burger illustration looks broken: the bottom bun is rendered as a separate tan bar with a visible gap and horizontal offset from the patty/lettuce stack above it, making the graphic appear misassembled.
issues.suggestion: Fix the illustration asset so the burger layers (top bun, lettuce, cheese, patty, bottom bun) are vertically stacked and aligned without gaps or offset, or replace it with a correct image.
